steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Isolation Buffer (NIB-HEPES)
steps.instruction: Construct 50mL of NIB-HEPES using the specified stock concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 uL of 1M Tris HCl, pH 7.5 (for 10 mM final)
Add 100 uL of 5M NaCl (for 10 mM final)
Add 150 uL of 1M MgCl2 (for 3mM final)
Add 500 uL of 10% Igepal (for 0.1% final)
Add 500 uL of 10% Tween (for 0.1% final)
Fill to 50mL with ddH2O
Optional: Add 2 tablets of Pierce Protease Inhibitor Tablets (EDTA-Free) and vortex to dissolve
Store NIB on ice during use; stable at 4 °C for at least 1 month

steps.title: Prepare Instruments and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prechill all equipment and prepare the dounce homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Chill petri dish over dry ice to use as a surgery stage
Chill razor blades in dry ice
Fill a 7mL capacity dounce homogenizer with 2 mL NIB:HEPES and chill in wet ice
Chill dounce pestles in 70% ethanol in 15mL tubes on ice
Immediately before use, rinse pestles with chilled diH2O and wipe with kim wipes

steps.title: Section Primary Tissue
steps.instruction: Process the flash frozen primary tissue sample (~5mg) while keeping it frozen.

substeps.instruction: Cut tissue on the chilled surgery stage using the prechilled sterile razor blade

steps.title: Dounce Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue in the NIB:HEPES buffer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer tissue chunk via razor blade to the chilled dounce vessel
Allow 00:05:00 to equilibrate to the salt concentration of NIB:HEPES
Perform 5 loose (A) pestle strokes slowly, avoiding bubbles and staying below the water-level
Wait 00:05:00 for cells to equilibrate
Perform ~10 tight (B) pestle strokes until the solution is a slush

steps.title: Strain and Wash Nuclei
steps.instruction: Isolate nuclei from debris and wash the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Allow debris to settle for 00:05:00
Pass the supernatant through a 35uM strainer
Pass the remaining dounced solution and debris through the strainer (use multiple strainers if necessary)
Resuspend the resulting pellet in 1 mL NIB:HEPES
Repeat the spin down and resuspension for a second wash

steps.title: Quantify and Adjust Nuclei Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the nuclei suspension and adjust to 1400 nuclei/uL.

substeps.instruction: Take an aliquot of the sample and dilute 1:10 (10uL nuclei suspension in 90 µL NIB:HEPES)
Spin down the nuclei solution for 00:10:00 at 4 °C
Resuspend cells in 500 µL NIB:HEPES and hold on ice
Determine nuclei/uL concentration of the diluted aliquot using a Hemocytometer or BioRad TC20 Automated Cell Counter
Calculate the stock concentration and either concentrate via centrifugation/buffer removal or dilute with NIB:HEPES to reach 1400 nuclei/uL
Hold the final solution on ice

steps.title: Prepare Tagmentation Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the iTSM plate with nuclei and transposase on ice.

substeps.instruction: Combine 420 µL of 1400 nuc/uL solution with 540 µL of 2X TD Buffer
Pipette 8uL of this TD Buffer:Nuclei solution into each well of a 96 well iTSM plate
Add 1uL of 2.5uM uniquely indexed SBS12-U-ME TSM per well
Ensure the SBS12-U-ME TSM plate, nuclei, and tagmentation plate are held on ice throughout preparation

steps.title: Tagmentation and Pooling
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate to tagment DNA and pool the reactions.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 55 °C for 00:10:00 while shaking at 300 rpm
Place plate on ice for 00:02:00 to allow reactions to cool
Pool the full plate on ice
Add 2 µL of 5mg/mL DAPI to the pool
If visible chunks remain, strain the pool through a 40um cell strainer

steps.title: Sort Nuclei into PCR Plate
steps.instruction: Sort DAPI+ nuclei into a prepared 96 well plate.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 96 well plate with 9 µL of 1X TD Buffer (diluted with ddH2O) per well
Using a cell sorter (e.g., Sony SH800S), sort 15 DAPI+ nuclei per well
Maintain sample chamber and pool at 4 °C if possible
Centrifuge the plate at 500 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes
Optional: Store plates at -20 °C for up to 1 week

steps.title: Gap-Fill and Linear Extension
steps.instruction: Perform gap-filling and adapter switching via linear extension.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 0.1% SDS to each well
Add 4 µL of NPM to each well (must be added step-wise, not pre-combined)
Incubate plate at 72 °C for 00:10:00, then hold on ice
Add 1.5 µL of A14-LNA_ME at 1uM (final concentration 100 nM)
Perform 10 total cycles of linear extension: 98 °C for 00:00:30, 98 °C for 00:00:10, 59 °C for 00:00:20, and 72 °C for 00:00:10
Hold at 10 °C

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify libraries using real-time PCR with SYBR fluorescence monitoring.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 to each well to quench SDS (10:1 TritonX:SDS ratio)
Perform real-time PCR (16-18 cycles): 98 °C for 00:00:30, 98 °C for 00:00:10, 55 °C for 00:00:20, 72 °C for 00:00:30 (measure SYBR fluorescence), and 72 °C for 00:00:10
Stop PCR once SYBR fluorescence stops exponential growth
Hold at 72 °C for 00:02:00, then hold at 10 °C
Optional: Store plates at -20 °C for 10 weeks or 4 °C for 5 weeks

steps.title: Library Cleanup and Size Selection
steps.instruction: Pool PCR products and perform SPRI bead size selection (> 200 bp).

substeps.instruction: Pool 25 uL from each well into a 15mL conical tube
Perform 1X SPRI bead size selection (selecting for DNA > 200 bp)
Add 50 µL of MagPure NGS Binding Beads (room temperature, vortexed for 10s) to column elution
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00
Place on magnetic rack for ~00:02:00, remove and discard elution
Wash bead pellet twice: resuspend in 100 µL 80% ethanol (v/v), pellet on rack, and discard ethanol
Spin briefly on tabletop centrifuge, return to rack, and remove remaining ethanol

steps.title: Final Elution and Quantification
steps.instruction: Elute DNA and quantify the final library.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads off magnetic rack in 31 µL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00
Place on magnetic rack for ~00:02:00 and transfer elution to a clean tube
Quantify DNA concentration using 1uL of sample with Qubit DNA High-sensitivity kit
Dilute sample to 2 ng/uL using 10mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0
Run 2 uL sample on Agilent Tapestation 4150 (DNA High Sensitivity D5000 or D1000)
Load libraries according to Illumina standard loading concentrations
